name: x0_unguarded
description: Adversarial negative control (unnumbered, following two-principal-harness's x_confused_deputy.rs convention): a tiny window that only fits one of five ready tasks at a time. Exists so PR-B's `Unguarded` mutant strategy (admits every ready task regardless of quota) has a fixture where it visibly diverges from any honest strategy's admitted count — this PR only freezes the fixture; the verifier that would actually catch the divergence is PR-B's job.
